correctness.rationale: Derived the full stagewise five-state recurrence from the primary equation; computed its exact 3-step characteristic cubic symbolically; applied necessary/sufficient cubic Schur inequalities for all real |mu|<1; showed a real multiplier <-1 below the rational threshold, a simple -1 multiplier at equality, and full Schur stability above. Proved independently that every constant integer delay is stable by an exact unit-circle identity and Rouché, and that the continuous variable-delay equation is exponentially stable by the Halanay inequality. verify.py reproduces symbolic polynomial and algebra; explicit histories exist from nonzero Floquet eigenvectors.

value.rationale: A natural periodic grid delay exposes a sharp failure mode in an otherwise fixed-delay-unconditionally-stable second-order IMEX family. The rational necessary-and-sufficient switching threshold, together with stability of every physical bounded-delay solution and every frozen discrete recurrence, provides a concrete benchmark for common-Lyapunov or switching safeguards; it is not an arbitrary finite table or routine restatement.
